verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI app-builder SaaS, so the axis applies, but nothing in the pack shows v0's core product can be run on user infrastructure. The GitHub sync, export, API and SDK evidence covers exporting generated code or calling v0's hosted service programmatically, not self-hosting v0 itself. Deployment is described as running on Vercel infrastructure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
